result.title: Puzzle: One Pass Is Not Enough for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
result.summary: Open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation (OVRSIS) enables the segmentation of unseen classes without additional annotation or retraining. By analyzing the predictions of existing OVRSIS methods, we find that many misclassified patches coexist with visually similar, correctly classified patches of the same class within the same image. Unfortunately, most of these methods stop after a single inference rather than using their predictions to guide further inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Puzzle}, a plug-and-play iterative re-inference framework that combines prediction history with a visual-similarity prior to progressively refine patch-level attention. Puzzle employs a lightweight history-conditioned controller to regulate each patch's contribution as an information source and its reliance on visually similar patches, while an adaptive stopping rule determines when to stop. It keeps the segmentation model frozen and reuses the same controller across different models and datasets without retraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements across diverse OVRSIS models and datasets, highlighting the strong transferability of Puzzle. Moreover, Puzzle can further improve the performance of SOTA methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Puzzle：针对开放词汇遥感分割，用预测历史与视觉相似性先验驱动即插即用的迭代重推理，以轻量控制器调节各 patch 作为信息源及对相似 patch 的依赖，并由自适应停止规则决定何时结束，分割模型保持冻结。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「历史条件状态 + 自适应停止 + 相似证据复用」的迭代重推理结构，可为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的方法线索，但作用于分割输出层而非内部 latent 状态，迁移价值待验证。
